name: Classical Strings
_note: ADDED 2026-09-25 on Daniel's instruction: 'add a new offer to the site. classical strings from solo violin duet, trio or quartet. this is offered as a style, not a named act.' The offer arrived with a violinist's email to hello@ the same afternoon (a resume, a recordings playlist and a wedding and event violin repertoire list), and the song list on the page is that list, published as an example of what the booking offers. Nobody is named anywhere on the page, in alt text or in schema, on his instruction ('do not name the person live'), and the player's own recordings are not embedded because the YouTube player overlay prints the channel name. Search demand checked the same day: 'string quartet denver', 'string quartet wedding denver', 'wedding violinist denver', 'violinist denver', 'string quartet colorado springs' and 'string quartet for corporate events' autocomplete, with a cost family behind them ('string quartet cost per hour', 'average cost string quartet wedding ceremony'), so the page lives at /ensembles/string-quartet/ and its title carries string quartet and wedding violinist. The four configurations are his; the instrumentation at each size is stated as product fact.
spec: Violin, viola and cello, from one violinist to the full string quartet
material: Classical, hymns and popular songs arranged for strings
_bucket_note: Cocktail is arrival through dinner, which is where strings play: the ceremony prelude, the cocktail hour, the doors of a gala, a dinner. Budget because the solo violin is a one-musician booking, and that tag is reserved for acts with a solo size.
_img_note: REPLACED 2026-09-25, the same afternoon it shipped. The first card was a violin drawn flat in scripts/format_art.py (img/string-quartet-card.jpg, still in the repo with its ledger row, rebuild with `python3 scripts/format_art.py`). Daniel then pointed at the violinist's own site ('does she have photos on her website that we can use, permission is already granted'), so the card and og image are her wedding hero, cropped 16:9 through scripts/act_media.py photo --card: an outdoor mountain ceremony with the couple soft behind her. Three more of her performance photographs sit in the page's footage section. Held back, with the reason in that section's comment: the two portraits and the seated bench shots (a portrait is not the act as booked, and this is a spec'd style), the teaching photo (lessons, not this offer), and the portrait crop of the same ceremony frame. Alt text names nobody.
alt: A violinist playing at an outdoor mountain wedding ceremony, with the couple at a flowered arch behind her.
_video_note: EMBEDDED 2026-09-25 on Daniel's 'yes' to the question of whether the violinist's own recordings go on the page although the YouTube player prints her channel name. Five clips from her channel, all checked playableInEmbed the same day and recorded in media-sources.json: the Andante from Bach's Sonata No. 2 is the hero (one unaccompanied violin, the prelude sound a ceremony buyer is picturing); the Beethoven Op. 18 No. 6 quartet (the four-piece sound), the Bach Allegro, the Paganini Caprice No. 19 and the first movement of the Sibelius concerto sit in the footage grid. Nothing she publishes was held back. Iframe titles, VideoObject names and alt text name nobody; the ledger carries the channel as provenance.
card_line: One violinist or a string quartet for the ceremony, the cocktail hour, a gala or a memorial.
blurb: The first notes of Canon in D, and every guest stands up and turns around. That's what most couples are picturing when they ask for strings, and it's the same sound at the entrance of a gala and under a long dinner. Classical strings book as one violinist, a duo, a trio or the full string quartet of two violins, viola and cello, playing Bach for the aisle and Coldplay arranged for strings while the drinks go around.
